messages.subject: Project Beacon - completion bible binding
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

The printers have finished the Project Beacon completion bibles (the Meadowbank acquisition that completed earlier this year). Two hard copies plus USB - shall I courier one set to Crestview and keep one for the file? Also they've queried whether you want the disclosure bundle indexed separately.

Donna
